sectionIntroduction: Across Varsity, CAA Quebec, Subaru Canada, and Metagenics, I’ve contributed to reusable multi-brand interfaces, complex checkout and payment integrations, accessible vehicle configuration, and client knowledge transfer.
sectionClosingText: Across these projects, I’ve grown from delivering features to investigating underlying problems, establishing reusable patterns, coordinating across teams, and helping others own the finished solution. That is the approach I bring to composable commerce: understand the business flow, make the technical complexity manageable, and follow the work through to delivery and handoff.

heading: Making a shared platform dependable
narrative: Working on a multi-brand B2B/B2C platform with Next.js, commercetools, and Contentstack, I contributed to reusable interfaces, design tokens, and data-fetching improvements. When CMS deployments repeatedly broke references, I investigated the tooling and traced the issue to dependency processing order. I introduced a two-step deployment workflow that preserved references and reduced manual repairs.
challenge: CMS deployments repeatedly broke references in a shared multi-brand B2B/B2C platform built with Next.js, commercetools, and Contentstack.
ownership: I contributed reusable interfaces, design tokens, and data-fetching improvements, investigated the deployment tooling, and traced the broken references to dependency processing order.
outcome: I introduced a two-step deployment workflow that preserved references and reduced manual repairs.

heading: Bringing structure to complex checkout
narrative: I took responsibility for a checkout with substantial business logic, conditional steps, pricing, validation, and persistent state. I clarified server and client responsibilities, moved appropriate pricing work to server-side rendering, and helped standardize reusable form patterns. These improvements made the implementation easier to maintain and supported a broader team improvement in delivery.
challenge: Checkout combined substantial business logic, conditional steps, pricing, validation, and persistent state.
ownership: I took responsibility for the checkout, clarified server and client responsibilities, moved appropriate pricing work to server-side rendering, and helped standardize reusable form patterns.
outcome: The implementation became easier to maintain, supporting a broader team improvement in delivery.

heading: Connecting vehicle discovery, configuration, and accessibility
narrative: At Subaru Canada, I worked across vehicle discovery, Build & Price, and customer-service interfaces in a Next.js, TypeScript, and Contentstack platform. I implemented trim navigation and routing, corrected accessory pricing and configuration-state issues, and improved responsive comparison interfaces. I also built the General Inquiry frontend and improved keyboard interactions, semantic structure, and focus management across shared components. These contributions helped keep pricing and selections consistent and made bilingual customer journeys more usable across devices.
challenge: Vehicle discovery and Build & Price needed to preserve customer selections and present consistent pricing, while supporting accessible, responsive experiences in English and Canadian French.
ownership: I implemented trim navigation and routing, corrected accessory pricing and configuration persistence, improved comparison interfaces and shared-component accessibility, and built the General Inquiry frontend with address lookup and validation.
outcome: Pricing summaries and selected configurations became more consistent, mobile and bilingual interactions improved, and customers could navigate more accessible vehicle-discovery and inquiry experiences.

heading: Handling the complexity behind express payments
narrative: I worked on checkout and express payment integrations involving Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal. The challenge was coordinating native payment flows with shipping updates, cart totals, payment authorization, and existing checkout state. I contributed implementation, technical guides, reviews, and rollout planning. I helped shape an authorization change that reduced sequential backend calls from six to three, and caught inconsistencies in payment-clearing behavior during review. I also transferred payments knowledge to the client team, covering the workflows and decisions they needed to take ownership.
